subject: Pilot approval & procurement roadmap — next steps and buyer confirmation
message_1_subject: Pilot approval & procurement roadmap — next steps and buyer confirmation
message_1_body:
Hi Samira —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot scoped and routed through procurement: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: 6-week inference pilot to validate 95th percentile latency under production workload (1000 concurrent users).
- Success criteria: <1.2s p95 for text generation, total monthly token cost under $4k for pilot cap, and no PII exfil risk per your security rubric.
- Technical fit: Redwood supports model variants you requested; we can run in dedicated capacity in us-west for latency.

What we need from BrightBridge to progress:
1) Economic buyer / budget owner confirmation — who owns the pilot budget? We need the person who can sign off on $Xk pilot spend.
2) Procurement contact — name and PO process (any standard SOW/PO templates, payment terms, and preferred contracting cadence).
3) Security evidence requests — you mentioned SOC 2 and network isolation requirements. I attached our short security questionnaire (RBW-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx) and a one-page Pilot Plan (Redwood-Pilot-Plan.pdf) for your team to review.

Proposed next steps:
- If you can confirm the budget owner and procurement contact this week, we’ll draft a 6-week MOU and an itemized pilot quote.
- I can loop in our contracts lead (Marissa) and solutions engineer (Dev) for a 30-min procurement + security intro call.

Would you be available for a short call Wednesday or Thursday afternoon PST? If easier, reply with the procurement contact and we’ll send calendar options.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Redwood-Pilot-Plan.pdf (1 page), RBW-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx (xls)
message_2_subject: Re: Pilot approval & procurement roadmap — next steps and buyer confirmation
message_2_body:
Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap and materials — useful. Quick answers below: 

1) Budget owner: Daniel Ruiz (CFO) will own the pilot budget and give sign-off for anything >$10k. Email: d.ruiz@brightbridge.ai

2) Procurement: Nina Patel (procurement manager) handles vendor onboarding and PO. nina.p@brightbridge.ai — she’ll need our standard vendor packet and a PO template (attached our BrightBridge PO template for reference).

3) Security: SOC 2 Type II report is required for vendors in our vendor risk program. Also need confirmation if you support BYOK (customer-managed keys) or a KMS integration.

I’ve attached our PO template. We can do the intro call Thursday 11/12 at 2:00pm PST — that works for Nina and me. If you need Daniel on the intro, I can invite him but he generally prefers a short pre-read and then a decision touchpoint after procurement has validated terms.

Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Product Ops | BrightBridge

Attachment: BrightBridge-PO-template.docx
message_3_subject: Fwd: Pilot approval & procurement roadmap — next steps and buyer confirmation
message_3_body:
Tessa / Dev —

Thanks for looping me in. A few suggested plays so we keep momentum and make it easy for procurement to say yes: 

- Prep a 1-page commercial summary: pilot cap, proposed billing cadence, cancellation terms, and a short clause on data handling. I can draft this and attach to the MOU.
- For SOC2: pull the latest report (we have a public summary + an auditor letter). Supply the SSP redacted if they ask.
- BYOK: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integration in Private deployments; hosted requires a KMS integration call. For pilot, offer a mitigation: restrict telemetry and a short-term escrow key if they insist.

Operational asks for the intro call on Thu 11/12 2pm PST: 
- Dev: be ready to demo the 95th percentile behavior and confirm the expected token billing for sample workload.
- Tessa: bring the commercial summary and proposed pilot MOU (I’ll prepare a starter).

I’ll also prepare a short procurement checklist for Nina to speed vendor onboarding.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
message_4_to: Samira Khan <samira.k@brightbridge.ai>, Nina Patel <nina.p@brightbridge.ai>, Daniel Ruiz <d.ruiz@brightbridge.ai>
message_4_subject: Re: Pilot approval & procurement roadmap — proposed MAP and call invite
message_4_body:
Hi Samira / Nina / Daniel —

Thanks for the quick replies and for confirming Daniel and Nina. I’ve pulled the items we discussed together into a short mutual action plan (MAP) and attached the commercial summary + pilot MOU for review. Key points below: 

Mutual Action Plan (proposed):
- Week 0: Procurement & security intake — BrightBridge to confirm PO terms and provide any vendor checklist items (Nina).  
- Week 1: Technical kickoff — Solutions demo and baseline performance run (Dev leads).
- Weeks 2–5: Pilot run — telemetry + weekly sync; Redwood provides 24/7 infra monitoring and token usage dashboard.
- Week 6: Review & decision — BrightBridge provides sign-off on p95 and cost; parties decide on production rollout or extension.

High-level commercial summary: pilot cap $9,500, 6-week term, net-30 billing after pilot completion, limited liability clause and standard DPAs attached in the MOU.

Links / attachments: 
- Pilot MOU & commercial summary: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPilotPlan
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
- Quick quote (DocuSign): https://app.docusign.com/quick/quote/BB-2026-0119

Call scheduling: I’ve provisionally booked Thu 2026-11-12 at 14:00 PST (30 min) and invited Nina and Samira — please accept or propose an alternate time. If Daniel prefers a brief pre-read instead of being on the call, Samira, could you confirm and we’ll send the one-pager for his review?

Two small asks for procurement to speed things up: 
1) Nina — can you share your vendor onboarding checklist (if different from the PO template) so Marissa can pre-fill any required fields?
2) Daniel/Samira — please confirm the budget owner threshold for auto-approval (you mentioned $10k) so we align the commercial ask.

Thanks all — cc’ing our contracts and solutions folks. We’ll bring the SOC2 summary to the call and confirm BYOK options with engineering if needed.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Redwood-Pilot-Plan.pdf, RBW-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx
